from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, tarfile
lab=Path("revenue/kaggriculture/cloud-execution-lab")
archive=lab/"exports/titan-current.tar.gz"
manifest=lab/"runtime/integrated-selected/CURRENT-SOURCE.json"
receipt_path=lab/"runtime/integrated-selected/CURRENT-ARCHIVE.json"
old_sha="a8af2b834bb5e1d6486245b9538c2de5a041085be38c7707d08e6d49e6149e89"
old=lab/"exports/historical"/f"titan-{old_sha}.tar.gz"
reference=lab/"reference/titan-current/deadline_adapter.py"
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def members(path):
    with tarfile.open(path,"r:gz") as tf:
        return {m.name:tf.extractfile(m).read() for m in tf.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
old_members=members(old); new_members=members(archive)
changed=sorted(name for name in old_members if old_members[name]!=new_members[name])
receipt=json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
result={
  "schema":"titan.canonical.deadline-adoption.v1",
  "runtime_source":{"git_blob":"f918325f36493bf4cfc46c274f57128fc7b0fc82",
    "sha256":sha(reference),"bytes":reference.stat().st_size},
  "previous_archive":{"sha256":sha(old),"bytes":old.stat().st_size,
    "historical_path":str(old.relative_to(lab))},
  "current_archive":{"sha256":sha(archive),"bytes":archive.stat().st_size},
  "current_manifest":{"sha256":sha(manifest),"bytes":manifest.stat().st_size,
    "runtime_files":receipt["runtime_files"]},
  "current_receipt":{"sha256":sha(receipt_path),"bytes":receipt_path.stat().st_size},
  "package_changed_members":changed,
  "local_tests":{"methods":6,"failures":0,"errors":0,"skipped":0,"successful":True},
  "scope":"exact source adoption and deterministic package publication; no games, policy calls, submission or upload"
}
assert result["runtime_source"]["sha256"]=="d6f818d856047add09489e7ee69ccb18a327c1afe3c47b317cd7a14858da5f04"
assert result["previous_archive"]["sha256"]==old_sha
assert result["current_archive"]=={"sha256":"3ead16eb674c34c818eafb54df9d07061a62198eb535069d65307a7e4e505ada","bytes":279745}
assert result["current_manifest"]["sha256"]=="b13ed4d3cb68c8a7ce12793cab65abd938ee5264d5cf1ae535dd74e255721522"
assert result["current_receipt"]["sha256"]=="79e96c2982d768f7741f67f49e175406af1c73c6832ab3b612e6ea8bddb93367"
assert changed==["SOURCE.json","reference/titan-current/deadline_adapter.py"]
(lab/"DEADLINE-REFERENCE-ADOPTION-RESULTS.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
PY_RESULT
